mapper.insert: insert into application_workspace_git_access_checks( user_id, application_workspace_id, status, reason, message, checked_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{row.userId}, #{row.targetId}, #{row.status}, #{row.reason}, #{row.message}, #{row.checkedAt}, #{now}, #{now} ) on conflict (user_id, application_workspace_id) do update set status = excluded.status, reason = excluded.reason, message = excluded.message, checked_at = excluded.checked_at, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

insert into local_workspace_git_access_checks( user_id, workspace_id, status, reason, message, checked_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{row.userId}, #{row.targetId}, #{row.status}, #{row.reason}, #{row.message}, #{row.checkedAt}, #{now}, #{now} ) on conflict (user_id, workspace_id) do update set status = excluded.status, reason = excluded.reason, message = excluded.message, checked_at = excluded.checked_at, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
